derivation: by ext x; apply congrFun; exact (denseRange G).equalizer f.hom.continuous_toFun g.hom.continuous_toFun (by funext y; simpa [GrpCat.comp_apply] using! (ConcreteCategory.congr_hom h y))
explanation: DenseRange.equalizer says continuous maps into a T2 space that agree on a dense range are equal. Applying it to the dense map eta G and converting h to equality on its range yields this morphism equality.
